name: savvy-progress
description: Lab blobs fork of savvy-progress: progress bar, agents panel with per-run blob colours, and a lab table of each agent's file work.

language.title: Panel language
language.description: auto follows Claude Code's language setting, then the system locale; en, ru or he (Hebrew, drawn right to left)

autoOpen.title: Open the agents panel
autoOpen.description: savvy: when a savvy-flow worker starts or a plan is reported; any: also when any other subagent starts

spritePack.title: Sprite pack folder
spritePack.description: Optional: a folder of your own terminal sprites, one set per agent state (<state>-<frame>.png and a pack.json). Empty: the lab blobs. A pack replaces the blobs in the terminal panel; it stays on your machine.
